title: Dependency Injection & Configuration
description: Understand dependency injection, configuration, middleware, and Program.cs in ASP.NET Core.
longDescription: This module explains dependency injection, a core feature of ASP.NET Core that enables loosely coupled code. You will also learn about the configuration system, middleware pipeline, and how everything is wired together in Program.cs.
whatYouLearn: Understand the dependency injection pattern and its benefits
Register and inject services in ASP.NET Core
Use scoped, transient, and singleton service lifetimes
Configure applications using appsettings.json and environment variables
Build and customize the middleware pipeline in Program.cs
